workflows.name: New Feature Implementation
workflows.description: Guided implementation of a new feature with spec, approval, and post-implementation hooks
workflows.trigger: Cuando vas a implementar una nueva funcionalidad
phases: FASE C: AGENT PROMPT PARA AGENT

workflows.name: CI Failure Auto-Heal Loop
workflows.description: Autofix CI failures using GitHub MCP logs + error-pattern-mining + tdd-workflow + critic gate.
workflows.trigger: CI build failure or compilation error detected on GitHub
phases: Read CI failure logs via GitHub MCP

workflows.name: Debug Session Workflow
workflows.description: Guided debugging of an unexpected error or behavior following ARQ protocol
workflows.trigger: Cuando encuentras un error o comportamiento inesperado
phases: PASO 3: Genera el AGENT PROMPT quirúrgico

workflows.name: Architecture Boundary Verification
workflows.description: Verify frontend/backend/DB layer separation is not violated.
workflows.trigger: Before major refactoring or boundary checks

workflows.name: Comprehensive Codebase Audit
workflows.description: Perform a comprehensive audit of the codebase structure, dead code, and architecture boundaries.
workflows.trigger: Before project cleanup or periodic architecture auditing

workflows.name: Dead Code Elimination
workflows.description: Remove unused files, unreachable code, and stale artifacts from the repo.
workflows.trigger: Periodic cleanup of unused exports, modules, or artifacts

workflows.name: Feature-Based Directory Restructure
workflows.description: Enforce src/features/<domain>/ structure across the frontend codebase.
workflows.trigger: When frontend components need to be reorganized into feature domains
phases: Map each component to its target domain
Confirm src/components/ contains only reusable UI

workflows.name: Domain-Module Directory Restructure
workflows.description: Move and enforce server/src/modules/<domain>/ structure across the backend.
workflows.trigger: When backend modules need to be reorganized into domain directories
phases: Map each file to its target domain module

workflows.name: Cross-Session Memory Load
workflows.description: Load cross-session memory and surface top risks from previous sessions.
workflows.trigger: At every session start or gap > 24 hours

workflows.name: Post-Task Hook Evaluation
workflows.description: Runs automatically after every completed agent task to evaluate quality.

workflows.name: Coverage Backlog Generation
workflows.description: Generate test specs for low-coverage domains based on coverage gaps.
workflows.trigger: When test coverage drops or backlog is needed

workflows.name: Error Digest Generation
workflows.description: Summarize error patterns to surface top recurring root causes.
workflows.trigger: When analyzing recurring errors over multiple sessions

workflows.name: LOW-FITNESS Evolution Workflow
workflows.description: Automate the optimization of underperforming agent skills.
workflows.trigger: Periodic audit or low fitness score detection

workflows.name: LOW-FITNESS Skill Evolution Workflow
workflows.description: Automate the evolution of low-fitness agent skills using scoring.
workflows.trigger: When skills need optimization or have fitness < 60%
